Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Looking at my own calendar, my free time that week is:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

Does one of those work for you? If none does, send me your free times and I'll fit the meeting in there.

Hi Professor Alvarez — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me. I've booked the CSE455 staff meeting then (Tuesday 15:00-15:30, with you).

For reference, my other free slots next week are: Monday 11:50-13:10, Wednesday 12:00-13:00 and 16:20-17:00, Thursday 12:00-12:50, Friday 11:00-12:20. See you Tuesday.
Perfect — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is; it's on my calendar now. Thanks for the other slots too, I'll keep them in mind. See you Tuesday.
